newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea bond yields end up ahead of reserve review.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea bond yields end up ahead of reserve review.

text.p: Key South Korean bond yields closed higher on Wednesday as
short-term liquidity tightened ahead of Thursday's central bank
review of won reserve levels at banks, dealers said.
The overnight call rate also rose slightly.
* 3-yr corporates close at 11.94 pct vs Tuesday's 11.92
* 3-mth CDs close at 12.05 pct vs Tuesday's 12.00
* Average overnight call at 11.99 pct vs Tuesday's 11.98
The overnight call rate slightly rose to 11.99 percent from Tuesday's 11.98 percent, but the rate at one point hit an intraday high of 12.10 percent, dealers said.
They forecast bond trading would continue to be slow on Thursday, also due to the reserve review.
